id: title:dmarticus:open the cloud task composer in command center

review.posthog_relevance: Adds Cloud Task Composer story and command center tile replacement behavior, potentially relevant to Command Center or Cloud-specific workflow visualization.
review.reason: The change introduces a `replaceExisting` parameter to clear unresolved tasks before creating new ones and adds Cloud-specific story components with a 2x2 grid layout. This represents a substantive, bounded capability improvement and UI implementation.
review.uncertainty: The exact production benefit and user adoption are not demonstrated; the change could be a story-only or command-center-specific feature without broader systemic impact.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, complete change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No adoption, incident, or effort claims are used. No tier is assigned; this chunk is not scored.

observations.behavior: Adds a replaceExisting parameter to startCreating, allowing clearing an unresolved task before creating a new one.
Adds replaceExisting parameter to startCreating action and its implementation, clearing the cell if replaceExisting is true and no existing task.
Adds CloudTaskComposer and StartingCloudTaskComposer story components with Cloud-specific configuration and a 2x2 grid layout.
